name: MINH THUAN
bio:
Backend-focused Software Engineer with 2+ years shipping web and mobile products end to end, including sixteen months of enterprise delivery on live customer-facing pages and a learning-management platform now running in production.
Core stack is .NET/C# and NestJS over PostgreSQL and Redis, with React and TypeScript on the frontend.
Focused on the parts that decide whether a system survives real users: REST API design, JWT authentication with RBAC and ownership checks, Clean Architecture and CQRS, distributed caching, rate limiting, and idempotent background jobs.
Tested at more than one level, the latest build shipping 205 backend tests across controller, service and in-memory-database integration layers, then packaged with Docker, Nginx and a Git-based GitHub Actions pipeline on Azure, Vercel and DigitalOcean.
Comfortable taking Java/Spring, Angular, or mobile in React Native and Kotlin when a project calls for it, working Scrum with Jira under enterprise change governance.
